scope: NAT01-04; final frozen primary run only; actual accepted LINE sink wire, not native LINE certification

rubric.PASS: User request handled correctly under explicitly disclosed basis, with actual wire.
rubric.PARTIAL: Useful accurate part delivered but a required interpretation/basis/clause is missing.
rubric.FAIL: Generic refusal/retry, lost context, no answer or specific clarification where actual fixtures support the request.
rubric.BLOCKED_FIXTURE: Successful source/preview path lacks prior receipt fixture; missing-evidence response reviewed separately and is not a pass.

notes: NAT01T1 exact numerical answer passed but documentary status basis missing; conservatively PARTIAL against the authored criterion.
NAT02T1 PASS is limited to truthful explicitly labelled received-money basis; does not certify invoiced sales or business profit.
NAT04 does not require PAID filter merely from the word จ่าย. A claim of actual paid money would require payment evidence; expense record totals with disclosed basis are acceptable.
No status is derived from old exact-tool scorer or earlier candidate runs; no production/native LINE claim.
